## What you did
- Cleared the ruff 0.8 backlog and two mypy errors in `kestrel/auth`, then split the 900-line `saml_utils.py` into a `saml/` package (assertions, metadata, bindings) with a shim keeping the old imports working — opened as PR #423 [1][4].
- Made the flaky SAML ACS tests deterministic with freezegun instead of sleeps: 50/50 green on repeat, and the file runs about 2s faster [1].
- A missing Issuer or Subject in an assertion is now a 401 with a clear error instead of an `AttributeError` surfacing as a 500 [1].

## What changed
- Maya approved and merged #418 (Fernhill assertion signatures); it goes out with tonight's staging deploy, so signature validation is on staging before Wednesday EOD [3].
- Tom requested changes on #423: he wants the module move split from the lint fixes, two PRs, and he'll approve both today [4].
- Zest Grocers' CSV export (#424) times out at ~230k rows; Tom took it and is moving the export to the job queue with an emailed link [5].

## What is still open
- #423 has to be split into two PRs before Tom can approve [4].
- Thursday 10:00 NY (16:00 Paris): Fernhill end-to-end SSO walkthrough on staging against their Okta tenant — Priya runs the demo, you only need to be on the call [1].
- The assertion-ID replay cache is still per-process; moving it to Redis is what closes replay across the three API pods — the work you lined up for today [1][2].
